reason: MindsEye is a DeepSeek Harness vision plugin whose primary purpose is native image understanding, grounding, generation, and editing through configurable external models, with structured evidence, caching, and session memory.

summaries.zh: MindsEye 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供图像理解、定位、生成和编辑工具，并通过可配置的视觉模型返回结构化结果。
summaries.en: MindsEye adds image understanding, grounding, generation, and editing tools to DeepSeek Harness through configurable vision models with structured results.

capabilities: Reads and analyzes images using configured external vision providers
Generates and edits images through configured image services
Stores image evidence and historical question-answer context in process memory
Uses caching to reduce repeated vision model calls
Mounts vision and memory tools into the host conversation
